schema.description: One therapy session as a Philips DreamStation recorded it on its SD card: the summary file's times, settings and statistics, and a tally of the events file. Only what the device wrote. Indexes such as AHI, and anything per night, are reads over these facets. This is the DreamStation leaf of health.cpap-session, the device's own payload shape named for its vendor. Version 1 is health.cpap-session v1 under its leaf's name, every rule unchanged; the vendor-leaf rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json in anam) carried each facet across as the next version of itself. Version 2 requires source_time, every other rule unchanged. Version 3 only rewords this description.

device_serial.description: The device's serial number, from PROP.TXT (LOINC 69993-4, as reference).

device_model.description: The model number, from PROP.TXT (LOINC 69991-8, as reference).

device_software.description: The device's software version, from PROP.TXT.

session.description: The session number the device gave this session; its files are named for it in hex.

start.description: When the session started, a UTC instant from the summary's header.

duration_seconds.description: How long the session ran, in seconds.

mask_on_spans.description: Each span the mask was on, as [start, end] in seconds from the session start.

settings.description: The settings in force for the session. Pressures in cm H2O.

mode.description: Therapy mode, such as cpap, auto_cpap or bilevel.

pressure_min.description: Lower bound of the auto range.

pressure_max.description: Upper bound of the auto range.

flex_mode.description: Pressure relief: off, c_flex, c_flex_plus, a_flex, bi_flex, rise_time or p_flex.

comfort_flags.description: The raw comfort-settings byte, kept as the device wrote it.

pressure.description: The device's own pressure summary for the session, cm H2O.

device_counts.description: The device's own session counts, and minutes of each breathing pattern, from the summary file.

event_counts.description: How many of each event kind the events file records, by the decoder's name for the kind.

source_time.description: How the card's clock was read: value is start as the card's decoder gives it, from the session's UTC epoch on the card (basis source).

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
